title: Lab-Result Trend vs Target Range
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=labresult:value
| timechart span=1mon avg(value) as value by test
| untable _time test value
description: Trends your recurring lab results — cholesterol, HbA1c, kidney markers — against the healthy target range for each test.
value: Tracking labs over time reveals slow drifts a single result would hide, giving you time to change course.
implementation: Ingest lab-portal results into `index=personal`; trend each test and overlay its target band.
visualization: Line chart of each lab value over time with target-range shading.
grandmaExplanation: It follows your blood-test numbers over time so you can tell whether they are moving into or out of the healthy range.
